name: Wrentham Recreation Department
description_short: The Wrentham, MA town recreation department's online registration site. Families create a household account and then sign up for programs. This page does not describe any summer camp.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Wrentham Recreation Department: Online Registration by MyRec.com Recreation Management Software

warnings: This is the homepage of a town recreation department's general registration portal (MyRec.com), not a camp's own page. No summer camp is mentioned.
The only programs shown are a 2026 Turkeywacker 5K, Norfolk-Wrentham-Plainville youth basketball and adult pick-up basketball. None of these are camps.
There is no information on summer camp seasons, sessions, dates, prices or ages. Check the Programs/activities list for 2027 summer camp offerings.
